subjects.description: A black industrial robotic arm with a metallic two-finger parallel-jaw gripper mounted at its end, suspended from a base just outside the top of the frame
subjects.appearance_details: Glossy black powder-coated armature with visible joint segments, a silver-aluminum gripper assembly with two parallel fingers
subjects.relationship: Primary actor of the scene, manipulating the pear on the workbench
subjects.location: upper-center of frame, hovering above the workspace
subjects.orientation: Vertically oriented, gripper facing downward toward the workbench
subjects.pose: Suspended above the workspace with the gripper aligned over the pear
subjects.state_changes: Gripper opens and lowers around the pear, closes to grasp; arm lifts and translates left toward the bowl; arm descends and gripper opens to release; arm retracts upward and slightly right to a neutral position

subjects.description: A yellow-green pear with smooth waxy skin
subjects.appearance_details: Classic pear shape with a rounded base tapering to a narrower neck, a short brown stem at the top, faint pale-yellow speckling on the skin
subjects.relationship: Object being manipulated by the robotic arm
subjects.location: front-center of the workspace, slightly closer to the camera than the other objects
subjects.action: being grasped, lifted, translated, and released into the dark bowl
subjects.state_changes: Lifted by the gripper, carried laterally to the upper-left, released and settles into the dark bowl with a small natural roll

subjects.description: A small dark gray ceramic bowl
subjects.appearance_details: Matte dark-gray exterior, shallow rounded shape, smooth even rim
subjects.action: stationary, receives the pear at the end of the sequence
subjects.state_changes: No significant change until the pear is released into it

subjects.description: A pink rounded distractor object resembling a small soft wedge or block
subjects.appearance_details: Soft pink color, smooth rounded form, similar footprint to the bowl
subjects.relationship: Distractor object adjacent to the pear; not manipulated
subjects.location: center-left of the workspace, between the bowl and the pear

background_setting: A clean, white laboratory workbench surface fills the frame. The background beyond the workspace is a uniform pale wall, lightly shaded, lending the scene a controlled, neutral, lab-grade aesthetic. The workbench is uncluttered apart from the bowl, the pink object, and the pear.

lighting.conditions: Bright, even, diffuse studio-grade lab lighting
lighting.direction: Top-lit, broad overhead source producing uniform illumination
lighting.shadows: Soft, short shadows cast directly beneath each object on the workbench surface
lighting.illumination_effect: Crisp, color-neutral exposure across the entire workspace with no hot spots or color casts

aesthetics.composition: Top-down medium shot with the workspace centered in the frame; the bowl, pink object, and pear arranged in a loose triangular composition from upper-left to front-center
aesthetics.color_scheme: Predominantly white and pale gray workbench with accent colors of pink (distractor), dark gray (bowl), yellow-green (pear), and matte black (robotic arm)

cinematography.camera_motion: Locked-off, tripod-fixed overhead camera; the viewpoint is identical in every frame of the video
cinematography.focus: Workbench surface and the three objects

style_medium: Live-action video filmed from a locked-off overhead camera
context: Robotic pick-and-place demonstration on a laboratory workbench filmed from a locked-off overhead camera

actions.description: Robotic arm descends along a vertical axis toward the pear, gripper opening as it approaches
Gripper closes gently around the pear, securing it
Arm lifts the pear several centimeters above the workbench, then translates laterally to the upper-left toward the dark bowl, keeping the pear level throughout
Arm positions the pear over the bowl, pauses briefly, then lowers and releases the pear, which settles into the bowl with a small natural roll
Arm retracts upward and slightly to the right, returning to a neutral position above the workspace

segments.description: Continuous single-shot pick-and-place of the pear into the dark bowl by the robotic arm, filmed from a locked-off overhead camera
segments.key_changes: Pear is grasped, lifted, translated, released into the bowl; arm returns to a neutral position

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the workbench is shown with the robotic arm hovering above. At 0:01 the arm descends toward the pear. At 0:02 the gripper closes around the pear. At 0:03 the arm lifts the pear above the workbench. At 0:04 the arm carries the pear left toward the dark bowl. At 0:05 the arm pauses over the bowl, then begins to lower. At 0:06 the pear is released and settles into the bowl with a small natural roll. At 0:07 the arm retracts upward and slightly to the right. At 0:08 the arm has returned to a neutral position above the workspace.
audio_description: Quiet laboratory ambient room tone, faint mechanical whir of the robotic arm during motion, soft thuds when the gripper engages and when the pear settles into the bowl; no speech or music.
